The Cash & Trade Proc Mgr. is an intermediate level role responsible for ensuring transactions are processed accurately and on time in coordination with the Transaction Services team. The overall objective is to manage a Cash and Trade Operations team, apply in-depth disciplinary knowledge to reach solutions and ensure deliverables are completed efficiently and accurately.
Responsibilities:
Review service quality, production systems, and client reporting within cash and trade operations
Analyze complex and variable issues to resolve issues and ensure team deliverables meet performance and quality expectations
Recommend quality reviews of cash management services, production systems, and client reporting
Manage performance, identify areas of development/training and make recommendations for pay increases, promotions, terminations, hiring, etc. of team
Contribute to planning, budget management and formulation of procedures
Serve as backup to the Cash and Trade Operations Senior Manager
Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency, as well as effectively supervise the activity of others and create accountability with those who fail to maintain these standards.

At least 5 years of relevant experience in compliance checking (documents scrutiny).

Goods and service trade.
FDI (Foreign Direct Investment), ODI (Overseas Direct Investment) and foreign debt, capitalization foreign exchange settlement facilitation program.
Reporting requirement from regulator.
Familiar and master of foreign exchange and cross border RMB regulations under China Shanghai Pilot Free Trade Zone and other special area regulator in Shanghai, cross-border investment and financing etc.
Known well of Bank FX Simplification Program(外汇展业)
Excellent both English speaking and writing.

We are looking for a highly experienced and strategic Head of Operations to establish and lead the entire operational framework for our new brokerage in China. This is a unique opportunity to build a world-class operations department from scratch. The ideal candidate will be a hands-on leader with deep expertise in China's securities market, regulatory landscape, and operational best practices. You will be responsible for designing, implementing, and managing all operational processes, systems, and teams to ensure efficiency, scalability, and full compliance with Chinese regulations.
Key Responsibilities
Operational Strategy & Setup:
Develop and execute the end-to-end operational strategy for the new brokerage.
Lead the setup of all operational infrastructure, including clearing, settlement, custody, and client services.
Select, implement, and integrate key operational systems and technologies (e.g., OMS, PMS, back-office systems, Rootnet)
Regulatory Compliance & Risk Management:
Ensure all operations are fully compliant with regulations from the China Securities Regulatory Commission (CSRC), the State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE), and other relevant authorities.
Establish and maintain robust internal controls, policies, and procedures (e.g., for AML/KYC, trade processing, and data privacy).
Develop and oversee the firm's operational risk management framework to identify, mitigate, and report risks.
Team Leadership & Development:
Build, train, and lead a high-performing operations team.
Foster a culture of excellence, accountability, and continuous improvement.
Set performance goals and provide ongoing coaching and development for team members.
Core Operations Management:
Oversee daily operations including trade capture, confirmation, clearing, and settlement for equities.
Manage cash management, and securities financing operations.
Establish and manage the client onboarding process, ensuring efficient and compliant KYC and account opening procedures.
Stakeholder & Vendor Management:
Act as the primary liaison with key external partners, including local exchanges (SSE, SZSE), clearing houses (CSDC, SHCH), custodian banks, and technology vendors.
Collaborate closely with internal departments, including Front Office, Compliance, Finance, and Technology, to ensure seamless business integration.
Financial & Performance Management:
Develop and manage the operations department's budget.
Define, monitor, and report on key performance indicators (KPIs) to drive efficiency and service quality.
Lead projects aimed at process optimization and automation.
Qualifications
Experience:
Minimum of 15+ years of experience in securities brokerage operations, with at least 7 years in a senior leadership role (e.g., Head/Director of Operations).
Proven track record of setting up and managing operations for a securities firm in mainland China is essential.
Extensive experience in a start-up or new business launch environment is highly desirable.
Knowledge & Skills:
In-depth knowledge of China's A-share market, fixed income market, and related financial products.
Expert understanding of the Chinese regulatory environment, including rules set by CSRC, PBOC, and SAFE.
Strong familiarity with local market infrastructure, including CSDC, CFETS, and major exchanges.
Demonstrated ability in process design, re-engineering, and implementing operational systems.
Excellent leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills.
Education & Language:
Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field. An MBA or other advanced degree is a plus.
Fluency in Mandarin Chinese is mandatory.
Professional proficiency in English is highly preferred.

jobs.descriptionText:
Business Function
Group Finance aims to deliver world-class standards in reporting, financial planning and finance processes. We provide insights and analyses that help the bank make sound business decisions – whether in the areas of product development or customer profitability. We also provide capital management, business planning, forecasting, and tax and accounting advisory services.
About the Role:
We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced product/financial controller to join our Global Financial Markets Business Finance team. The ideal candidate will play a pivotal role in strengthening the bank's financial control framework and ensuring robust end to end control processes within a dynamic and complex financial landscape. This position presents a distinctive opportunity to directly influence the integrity and robustness of our financial reporting, foster collaboration with senior leaders across diverse departments to enhance comprehension of the bank's operations and strategic direction, and contribute meaningfully to the strategic growth of our Global Financial Markets business
Responsibilities:
Drive the establishment and continuous enhancement of end-to-end control processes across the entire lifecycle of treasury products, vanilla & structured. This includes supporting new product launches, financial booking, valuation, hedge accounting, and regulatory reporting, ensuring the integrity and robustness of control frameworks for treasury products and their associated derivative hedges, from inception to maturity.
Leverage extensive experience with a diverse range of treasury products to provide expert guidance and oversight in product control functions. This includes performing in-depth analysis of P&L attribution, balance sheet substantiation, and reconciliations to ensure the accuracy and completeness of financial statements
Provide holistic support and expert guidance to navigate fast-evolving regulatory changes impacting financial market products. This includes proactive adaptation within the end-to-end control framework, leading efforts in supporting financial and regulatory reporting requirements.
Demonstrates comprehensive knowledge of treasury products and complex accounting standards, coupled with practical expertise in hedge accounting principles (e.g., fair value, cash flow, net investment hedges) and their effective application in a dynamic financial market environment.
Utilize advanced proficiency in financial market systems, such as Murex, to enhance operational efficiency, ensure accurate data capture, validation, and reporting for treasury products. Champion initiatives to improve system utilization and data quality.
Demonstrate a profound understanding of structured product booking intricacies, encompassing initial recognition, subsequent measurement, and their complete end-to-end process flows, including system configurations and data integrity.
Interpret, implement, and enforce complex financial regulations and internal policies effectively, contributing to the bank's robust compliance framework and mitigating potential risks across Global Financial Markets.
Requirements:
10+ years of progressive experience in product control or financial reporting, with a significant portion ideally within a Global Financial Markets environment. This should include demonstrable experience in leading significant projects.
Demonstrated expertise in designing, implementing, and enhancing end-to-end control processes within financial institutions.
Strong practical experience with a broad range of treasury products. In-depth knowledge of financial instruments, valuation methodologies, and accounting standards.
Proficiency in hedge accounting principles and their practical applications.
Familiarity with financial market systems like Murex is highly desirable.
Solid understanding of complex structured product booking and their end-to-end processes.
Good understanding of financial reporting requirements for complex structured financial products.
Familiarization with HKMA regulatory reporting requirements in treasury products preferred.
Good understanding of HKMA regulatory reporting processes and tools would be beneficial.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to articulate complex financial concepts clearly and concisely to diverse stakeholders, including senior management, business teams, and external auditors.
Proven ability to drive collaboration, foster strong relationships across various teams, and effectively influence outcomes in a matrixed organization.
A proactive, results-oriented leader capable of working effectively under pressure in a fast-paced Global Financial Markets environment, consistently delivering high-quality outcomes.
Demonstrated ability to lead, mentor, and develop team members, fostering a culture of continuous learning and high performance.
Strategic thinking ability to interpret and apply complex financial regulations and internal policies strategically, contributing to the overall risk management and compliance posture of the bank
Apply Now
We offer a competitive salary and benefits package and the professional advantages of a dynamic environment that supports your development and recognises your achievements.
We regret only shortlisted candidates will be notified.

Job Summary
Trust is the first of a new breed of banks in Singapore – digitally native and focused on delivering a delightful customer experience. You will work in a fast-paced and collaborative environment to solve new and interesting challenges each day. Together with our Trust team, you will help shape the future of our bank.
As a Data Scientist, you'd be able to work on and solve many interesting challenges which we are facing, learn new ways of working, and help build delightful high-quality products for our customers.
We are looking for a Data Scientist to help building our Enterprise Data Foundation for our digital venture in Singapore and analyze large amounts of raw information to find patterns that will help improve our company. We will rely on you to build data products to extract valuable business insights.
In this role, you should be highly analytical with a knack for analysis, math and statistics. Critical thinking and problem-solving skills are essential for interpreting data. We also want to see a passion for machine-learning and research.
Key Responsibilities
Advanced Analytics and AI
Build and implement the Dashboard/Reporting platform, Machine Learning environment, and Analytics platforms (AWS, Google) with relevant stakeholders.
Develop predictive models and machine learning algorithms for propensity to buy, churn prevention, behavioural segmentation, and personalization across deposits, lending, investments, and bancassurance products.
Conduct AML, Credit Risk, and Fraud analytics, including detection models, scoring models, early warning indicators, transaction monitoring analytics, and anomaly detection.
Create and maintain fraud detection and prevention models (application fraud and transaction fraud) and continuously enhance detection logic based on emerging patterns.
Build and refine AML analytics such as suspicious activity detection, behavioural patterning, customer risk scoring, and model tuning to reduce false positives.
Develop and maintain credit scoring models, behavioural risk models, and portfolio monitoring analytics to support underwriting, line management, collections, and risk-based pricing.
Analyse large datasets from internal and third-party sources to drive optimization of products, customer experience, risk controls, marketing effectiveness, and business strategies.
Enhance data collection procedures to include features relevant for building robust product, risk, AML, and fraud analytic systems.
Process, cleanse, and verify the integrity of data used in model development and ongoing analytics.
Automate data ingestion pipelines and anomaly detection systems, ensuring continuous performance tracking.
Identify trends and patterns using exploratory data analysis, statistical techniques, and AI driven insights.
Present insights using clear storytelling, data visualization techniques, and actionable recommendations for business and risk stakeholders.
Execute ad hoc analyses across business, product, AML, credit, and fraud domains, presenting clear results to senior management.
Select features, build and optimize machine learning classifiers, and implement continuous improvements to models.
Model Governance
Develop processes, dashboards, and tools to monitor and analyse model performance, stability, drift, and data accuracy across Product, AML, Credit Risk, and Fraud models.
Support full model governance lifecycle including documentation, validation readiness, performance reporting, and compliance with internal model risk management standards.
Conduct periodic reviews of model inputs, assumptions, conceptual soundness, and operational effectiveness.
Monitor false positive/false negative rates, ongoing calibration needs, and performance degradation.
Collaborate with Model Validation, Compliance, Risk teams to ensure adherence to regulatory expectations and internal governance frameworks.
Ensure transparency, traceability, and reproducibility of all models—including versioning, change management, and governance artefact maintenance.
Provide clear reporting of model behaviours, risks, limitations, and performance outcomes to business, product, and risk committees.

Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

Advanced Analytics
AI technologies
Model Governance
Qualifications
Education: Bachelor
Language: English
5-7 years of experience manipulating data sets and building statistical models
Technical leadership in Gen Ai – Evaluate and select right LLM / RAG Architecture to deliver bank use cases
Design and Deploy Agentic AI workflow
Master’s or PHD in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science or another quantitative field.
Experience creating data architectures.
Experience of a variety of machine learning techniques (clustering, decision tree learning, artificial neural networks, etc.) and their real-world advantages/drawbacks.
Proven experience as a Data Scientist
Experience using statistical computer languages (R, Python, SLQ, etc.) to manipulate data and draw insights from large data sets.
Experience using business intelligence tools (e.g. Tableau, Data Studio) and data frameworks (e.g. Google Big Query, Big Table, Data Flow)
Problem-solving aptitude
Have a passion for discovering solutions hidden in large data sets and working with stakeholders to improve business outcomes.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills for coordinating across teams.
Excellent communication and presentation skills
Experience Agile way of working and tools (Jira, Confluence, Trello, Slack etc.)

streamline operation flow and improve users (including clients) experience and frontline productivity.
As PO, you will develop and maintain a vision for agile technology projects and be responsible for communicating the vision to the
scrum team. Be responsible for agile technology projects and features from concept to final implementation. In particular,
have a good understanding of wealth management products, it's processes and relevance to clients.
Define and own the strategic digital product vision and roadmap for the wealth management product suite.
Align product strategy with business goals, market trends, and client needs.
Develop a competitive product strategy across relevant asset classes (such as FX, equities, fixed income, structured products, OTC derivatives, funds, and insurance.)
Monitor market dynamics and regulatory changes, ensuring products remain competitive and compliant.
As PO you will work with architects, business stakeholders and development teams to ensure that business, quality and functional
goals are met with each release. Be responsible for the design, usability, quality and delivery of agile technology projects and features.
As the subject matter expert, this role is to determine business requirements, review technology project plans from the business
perspective, and ensure new technology capabilities are embedded in business processes to deliver benefits. Ensure smooth
execution on the ground, and communicate the changes delivered to relevant stakeholders including front office.

Review and understand key business policies and processes in Wealth Management in offering CMPS products and services to
both private banking and retail banking clients. Identify critical pain-points and articulate how planned / in-flight technology projects will solve them.

execution platforms and ensure that it is properly interfaced with multiple downstream booking systems.
The PO should have strong technical knowhow to improve front office systems performance and expand product penetration according to the business development.

stage of the agile development lifecycle (when a new project is created). The PO also needs to understand both the engineering and
business side of releases and be ultimately responsible for representing the end user’s needs.

front office and operations on requirements (e.g., a new electronic workflow to simplify layers of checking, or to auto-populate
repeated fields in client forms). Prioritise “must have” items vs. “good to have”.
Review technology plans and design specifications, to ensure business requirements are met and that benefits will be delivered.
Identify impact on critical processes within the Bank’s operational risk framework, and work with process owners and project teams to ensure robust controls.
Work with technology project teams to develop test plans. Co-ordinate business users to test new platforms or technology features that are developed. Ensure final delivery meets user needs.
Work with stakeholders in the front, middle and back offices to ensure successful “go live” of projects, from the business
perspective. Develop training material, co-ordinate briefings, design and execute communication plans. Gather feedback post-implementation, and track benefits captured.

scope and work with concerned stakeholders for its early resolution to bring back the project on track.
Conduct periodic briefings to senior management on progress of technology projects, from the business perspective. Highlight issues that require resolution.
People & Talent
Work towards strengthening the performance culture and reinforcement of accountabilities in products. Sharing the technical skills and experience with other team members.
Risk Management
Embed a risk culture that supports the Bank’s strategy and philosophy for the management of risk.
Ensure that effective arrangements are in place within WM in the region for the prevention of money laundering in line with the
Group Policy and Standards, respective country regulatory guidelines and local legal requirements. In particular, ensure that the obligations on reporting suspicious activities are met.
Ensure that Risk Management matters that are brought to the job holder’s attention are subject to direct remedial action and/or ensure adequate reporting to the relevant Risk Committees
Governance
At all times have an awareness and understanding of the regulatory framework, in which the Group operates, and the regulatory requirements and expectations relevant to the role.

Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across

Lead the business to achieve the outcomes set out in the Bank’s Conduct Principles
Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

Regional and Country Wealth Management Heads and WM Product Managers.
Key markets Segment Heads, IAs and RMs
Market/Credit/Operational Risk, Legal, Compliance, Middle Office and COO team
